requirements.rationale: The packet delivers the three segment names, the lead-ins with the 'primarily comprises' qualifier, and the listed items for each segment. For More Personal Computing, the list is shown ending at its third bullet (block 150), followed directly by the 'Windows and Devices' subsection heading (block 151). For Productivity and Business Processes, the delivered text ends at bullet 4 (ordinal 99). For Intelligent Cloud, it ends at bullet 2 (ordinal 122). The following blocks (ordinals 100 and 123) were not delivered, so the delivered text cannot show that no further bullets follow. The requirement asked for confirmation that the lists are complete, and that is only proven for More Personal Computing. The optional Note 18 corroboration was not delivered.

assessment.coverage_reason: All delivered facts are accurate and carry the required qualifiers. The delivered text does not show where the Productivity and Business Processes and Intelligent Cloud lists end, so the 'complete enumeration' requirement is only verified for More Personal Computing.

Deliver the block that immediately follows the Intelligent Cloud list (after block-000122, ordinal 123) to confirm that Enterprise and partner services is the last bullet.
Optionally add the Note 18 segment information as corroboration; this was not delivered.
Block-000151 (the 'Windows and Devices' heading) is marginal. Keep it only if it is needed to show where the More Personal Computing list ends; otherwise remove it.
